components.name: BottomSheet
components.description:
Figma Bottom-Sheet (4059:14161, page ❖ Bottom Sheet): Background/Container, top corners 28, Shadow/Top/Level-2, over the
Overlay scrim. Top-Indicator (40×5 Neutral/Subtle grabber) · Header-Bar (Heading/3 + 44px Tertiary close) · Search ·
Body (Modal: padding 20, gap 16 · Action: padding 4, 48px items) · Footer (Large buttons, padding 12/20).
Focus is trapped (shared Dialog `useModal`), Escape/scrim/drag-down close, and the sheet slides up/down with `usePresence`.

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the overlay is shown: keep it in state and set it from `onOpenChange` (the exit animation then plays).
Without `open` the overlay shows while it is mounted, e.g. `{show && <Dialog … />}`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false on Escape, a scrim click, the close button, or an action without its own handler.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called at the same moments as `onOpenChange(false)`: the overlay asks to close.

props.name: search
props.description: Figma Search slot (a Search, under the header).

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Action type: the item shown as Single-Selected (Active/Accent/Subtle + check).

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Action type: called with the item; the sheet closes unless `keepOpen` is set.

props.name: primaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }

props.name: secondaryAction
props.type: { label: ReactNode; onClick?: () => void; level?: ButtonLevel; disabled?: boolean; autoFocus?: boolean }

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Scrim tap, Escape and drag-down dismiss (default true).

props.name: inline
props.description: Render inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport (device previews, embedded demos).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default: the locale's “Close”.
